description: Booking, Payment, Invoice: the full business logic layer. Includes Invoice entity/repo, InvoiceType enum, exception classes (finalised), InvoiceService, BookingService with all booking rules and cancellation refund matrix, PaymentService with deposit/full payment logic, and the three controllers. Depends on FEAT-001 (Payment.refundAmount, BookingRepository.countByEventDateAndStatusIn) and FEAT-002 (GlobalExceptionHandler shell, auth infrastructure). Independent of FEAT-004.
steps: Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/entity/InvoiceType.java — enum with values BOOKING_CONFIRMATION, PAYMENT_RECEIPT, CANCELLATION_STATEMENT.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/entity/Invoice.java — @Entity @Table(name='invoice'). Fields: Long id (@Id @GeneratedValue IDENTITY), Booking booking (@ManyToOne @JoinColumn name='booking_id'), InvoiceType invoiceType (@Enumerated STRING), String invoiceNumber, LocalDate invoiceDate, BigDecimal totalAmount (@Column precision=10 scale=2), BigDecimal depositAmount, BigDecimal balanceDue, BigDecimal refundAmount, String notes (@Column columnDefinition='TEXT'), LocalDateTime createdAt (@CreationTimestamp @Column updatable=false). Use @Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Builder.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/repository/InvoiceRepository.java — extends JpaRepository<Invoice, Long>. Methods: List<Invoice> findByBooking_Id(Long bookingId); List<Invoice> findByBooking_IdAndInvoiceType(Long bookingId, InvoiceType type).
Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/exception/BookingNotAllowedException.java — extends RuntimeException, constructor(String message) calling super(message).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/exception/CancellationNotAllowedException.java — extends RuntimeException, constructor(String message) calling super(message). Also update GlobalExceptionHandler (created in FEAT-002) to explicitly handle these two exception types: @ExceptionHandler(BookingNotAllowedException.class) and @ExceptionHandler(CancellationNotAllowedException.class) both returning 409 CONFLICT with {error:'Conflict', message:ex.getMessage()}.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/InvoiceService.java — @Service, injects InvoiceRepository and EmailService. Methods: Invoice createBookingConfirmation(Booking booking, Payment payment) — builds Invoice with type=BOOKING_CONFIRMATION, invoiceDate=today, copies amounts from payment, sets notes='Deposit paid. Balance due: R{balanceDue}', saves, generates invoiceNumber='INV-'+year+'-'+String.format('%05d',id) then saves again, sends email; Invoice createPaymentReceipt(Booking booking, Payment payment) — type=PAYMENT_RECEIPT, notes='Paid in full.', sends email; Invoice createCancellationStatement(Booking booking, Payment payment) — type=CANCELLATION_STATEMENT, sets refundAmount from payment.getRefundAmount(), notes built from scenario (e.g. 'Deposit forfeited. Refund: R{amount}' or 'Non-refundable. No refund due.'), sends email; List<Invoice> getInvoicesForBooking(Long bookingId); Invoice getInvoice(Long invoiceId) throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/BookingService.java — @Service. Injects: BookingRepository, CateringPackageRepository, PaymentRepository, InvoiceService, EmailService, UserRepository. Method createBooking(BookingRequest req, String userEmail): (1) load User by email; (2) load CateringPackage by req.packageId, check isActive=true else throw BookingNotAllowedException('Package not available'); (3) check ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(LocalDate.now(), req.eventDate) >= 5 else throw BookingNotAllowedException('Event date must be at least 5 days from today'); (4) check countByEventDateAndStatusIn(eventDate, List.of(PENDING,CONFIRMED)) < 3 else throw BookingNotAllowedException('Event date is fully booked'); (5) totalPrice = pkg.pricePerHead * numberOfGuests; (6) transportCost = distanceKm > 15 ? (distanceKm - 15) * 25 : 0; totalPrice += transportCost; (7) save Booking(status=PENDING, bookingDate=today); (8) save Payment(totalAmount=totalPrice, depositAmount=totalPrice/2, balanceDue=totalPrice, depositPaid=false, fullyPaid=false, refundAmount=BigDecimal.ZERO); (9) return BookingResponse. Method cancelBooking(Long bookingId, String userEmail): (1) load booking; (2) verify booking.user.email == userEmail OR user has ROLE_ADMIN; (3) check status is PENDING or CONFIRMED; (4) load payment; (5) daysToEvent = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(today, eventDate); (6) apply refund matrix: if daysToEvent>3 && !depositPaid && !fullyPaid -> throw CancellationNotAllowedException('Nothing to cancel — no payment made'); if daysToEvent>3 && depositPaid && !fullyPaid -> refund=depositAmount, msg='Full deposit refunded'; if daysToEvent>3 && fullyPaid -> refund=totalAmount, msg='Full amount refunded'; if daysToEvent<=3 && depositPaid && !fullyPaid -> refund=ZERO, msg='Cancellation within 3 days of event. Deposit is non-refundable.'; if daysToEvent<=3 && fullyPaid -> refund=totalAmount-depositAmount (balance only), msg='Cancellation within 3 days. Deposit forfeited. Balance refunded.'; (7) payment.setRefundAmount(refund); booking.setStatus(CANCELLED); booking.setCancellationDate(today); (8) save both; (9) invoiceService.createCancellationStatement(booking, payment); (10) return CancellationResponse. Other methods: BookingResponse getBooking(Long id, String userEmail), List<BookingResponse> getUserBookings(String userEmail), List<BookingResponse> getAllBookings(). Include a private mapToResponse helper that populates BookingResponse including the nested PaymentSummary from the associated Payment (fetch via paymentRepository.findByBooking_Id).

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/service/PaymentService.java — @Service. Injects: PaymentRepository, BookingRepository, InvoiceService. Method processPayment(PaymentRequest req, String userEmail): (1) load Booking by req.bookingId; (2) verify booking.user.email == userEmail; (3) load Payment via paymentRepository.findByBooking_Id; (4) if payFull=true: check !fullyPaid, set fullyPaid=true, balanceDue=0, balancePaidDate=today, if !depositPaid also set depositPaid=true+depositPaidDate=today; call invoiceService.createPaymentReceipt; else: check !depositPaid, set depositPaid=true, depositPaidDate=today, balanceDue=totalAmount-depositAmount; call invoiceService.createBookingConfirmation; (5) booking.setStatus(CONFIRMED); save payment, save booking; return PaymentResponse. Method getPaymentForBooking(Long bookingId, String userEmail): load booking, verify ownership, load and return payment.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/controller/BookingController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/bookings'). All endpoints require auth. POST / -> bookingService.createBooking(@Valid @RequestBody req, authentication.getName()) returns 201. GET / -> bookingService.getUserBookings(auth.getName()) returns 200. GET /{id} -> bookingService.getBooking(id, auth.getName()). POST /{id}/cancel -> bookingService.cancelBooking(id, auth.getName()). GET /admin/all -> @PreAuthorize('hasRole(ADMIN)') bookingService.getAllBookings(). Add @EnableMethodSecurity to SecurityConfig to allow @PreAuthorize.

Create src/main/java/codewithnathi/Catering/controller/PaymentController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/payments'). POST / -> paymentService.processPayment(@Valid req, auth.getName()) returns 200. GET /booking/{bookingId} -> paymentService.getPaymentForBooking(bookingId, auth.getName()).
acceptance_criteria: InvoiceType enum has BOOKING_CONFIRMATION, PAYMENT_RECEIPT, CANCELLATION_STATEMENT
Invoice entity has invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, totalAmount, depositAmount, balanceDue, refundAmount, notes fields
InvoiceRepository has findByBooking_Id and findByBooking_IdAndInvoiceType methods
BookingService rejects bookings where eventDate is < 5 days from today
BookingService rejects bookings when 3+ PENDING/CONFIRMED bookings exist for that eventDate
Cancellation refund matrix: >3 days + deposit only = full deposit refund; >3 days + fully paid = full refund; <=3 days + deposit only = R0; <=3 days + fully paid = balance only
PaymentService creates deposit payment (Invoice 1) and full payment (Invoice 2) correctly
InvoiceService generates invoiceNumber in format INV-{year}-{05d id}

Exception classes BookingNotAllowedException and CancellationNotAllowedException were already fully implemented by FEAT-002; GlobalExceptionHandler already had both @ExceptionHandler methods. @EnableMethodSecurity added to SecurityConfig alongside @EnableWebSecurity.
